_comment: TRS Command — v1 battle-loop tuning. Every number the loop leans on lives here so it can be playtested without touching code. See games/strategy/DESIGN.md (Parts A + B).

puzzle._comment: TRS routing puzzle. `size` is the base grid (Launch Pad cascade adds its sizeDelta). `gen` knobs feed the shared preset's genPlan (grid-path-puzzle/presets/trs.js); `modifiers` tune how an ENEMY STATUS on YOUR component is FELT while you solve that component's route (the reflect-back of the puzzle-module status effects). `countdown` is the pre-start GO pause (excluded from the solve clock). `trapEntryMode:failFast` = crossing a hazard fails the run immediately.

gen._comment: Generation knobs passed to the preset genPlan. count.min MUST stay >= the highest min-chain (3, for Cleanse/Overclock) or those verbs become unsolvable — the preset dropped the legacy +1 singleton.

modifiers._comment: Per-status route friction. freeze->slow cursor (cells/sec = 6*freezeSlow); confuse->per-step veer chance; drain->payload icons decay (baseMs start, +stepMs each further icon); shatter->per-step chance to wander an un-crossed icon; burning->firehazard generation density. freeze+burning never co-occur (host cancels them).

potency._comment: POTENCY is the raw worth of a solved TRS route: the ComboEngine scores how many payload cells you chained on the path (the 'stack', 1..5) by looking it up in `stackCurve`; a Chain amplifier on the route multiplies the result by `chainMultiplier`. The resulting number (≈1..15) is then turned into game effect via the per-potency multipliers in `effects`/`defense`. Tune the FEEL of routing here (how much a longer/cleaner route is worth); tune the EFFECT of that worth in effects/defense.

effects._comment: Per-effect translation of a solved TRS combo's `value` (1..~15 potency) into game numbers. Statuses last whole TURNS (resolves): turns = clamp(round(potency/divisor), min, max). `minChain` = minimum payload icons that must be chained on the route for the solve to SUCCEED (1 for potency-scaled effects).

synergy._comment: Single-status focus bonuses (shatterAmp = Shatter alone +50%; frozenBrittle = Freeze alone +40%) PLUS the v2 pairwise combos. A combo fires wherever BOTH its statuses sit on one component (any enemy). Glass replaces the two single bonuses when both are present. Frozen+Burning cancel (no combo). Frozen+Drained is intentionally open (no combo yet).

defense._comment: v2 defensive verbs (potency from the solved combo's `value`). Harden = % off the FIRST incoming hit; lone Cleanse strips the OLDEST 1 status; Overclock banks build-credit for the next attack phase. `minChain` = min payload icons to chain for a successful solve (1 for potency-scaled; 3 for the non-scaled Cleanse/Overclock). `combos` tunes the Table E synergies.

coreShield._comment: The Reactor Core is protected by an indestructible shield: while UP, any attack on the Core deals 0 HP damage (statuses can still be applied, they just don't chip the Core). The shield falls only when enough shield-linked parts are destroyed. Each listed part contributes its percentage when DESTROYED; the shield drops once the destroyed parts' percentages sum to >= `threshold`. Default: Power Generator alone (100%) — destroy it to expose the Core. Example multi-part list: { generator: 60, weapon: 30, tower: 10, engine: 40 }.

cascade._lpComment: Launch Pad governs its owner's TRS quality on a GRADIENT: at full HP it EASES the grid (fewer blockers/traps, smaller grid = bonus scaled by HP); as it's damaged the bonus fades to baseline; DESTROYED it congests past baseline (the cliff). blockerBonus/trapBonus are added to densities; sizeDelta adjusts grid size.

archetypes._comment: Enemy targeting brains (non-Boss roster). damageBudget = total HP damage dealt across a defense-resolve, distributed per policy. `status` (or `statusPool`, picked at random) = the debuff the strike may also inflict, gated by statusChance. Up to 4 can be fielded together (config panel roster).

dreadnought._comment: Act boss — heavy, status-rich, spreads across your kit. priority 'highestHp' makes it adaptive (the weight fallback handles any loadout).
dreadnought.label: Dreadnought

siegebreaker._comment: Alternate boss (reserved for variety / later acts) — focused single-target shatter.
siegebreaker.label: Siegebreaker

run._comment: Roguelike run meta-layer (core/run.js). A run is the ordered `battles` list (escalating rosters); win the isFinal battle to win the run, lose any battle to end it. The player owns Core + `startComponents.pickCount` parts at the start and acquires the rest as rewards. All tuning is data-driven: combo-mods/component-mods are catalog `patch` objects deep-merged over the base config at battle time (no base mutation). Component (incl. Core) HP persists between battles.

escalation._comment: perBattleBudgetMult is raised to the battleIndex power and multiplied onto every archetype's damageBudget in effectiveConfig — later battles hit harder even with the same archetypes.

reward._comment: Between battles, offer `offerSize` choices. Each type's pool is filtered by current ownership/damage; types are weighted, empty pools skipped. guaranteeComponentUntilOwned forces at least one component offer while unowned parts remain so a run can always progress toward the full kit. A repair fallback guarantees the offer is never empty.

comboModCatalog._comment: patch keys mirror effects.synergy.combos[combo] (offense) or defense.combos[combo] (defense). `needs` = the two components that must be owned for the combo to be formable (offer-gating).

componentModCatalog._comment: patch shape mirrors the component-mod merge in effectiveConfig: hpBonus/armor on components[id], `effect` over effects[ATTACK_EFFECT[id]], `verb` over defense[DEFENSE_VERB[id]]. `component` must be owned to be offered.

loadouts._comment: Presets pre-select the 2 non-core starting components (the player can still go custom). burst = Glass-enabling offense (Freeze+Shatter); sustain = defensive backbone (Repair+Cleanse).

map._comment: StS-style node map (core/map.js). A run is a seeded branching DAG of rows ending in a boss; the player picks a path. Node types: start/enemy/elite/boss/shop/heal/upgrade. Battle rosters come from enemyPools by row band; difficulty escalates by row + tier (economy.tierBudgetMult). The legacy `battles` list above is ignored when a map is present.

economy._comment: Scrap currency. Earned on each battle win (more from elite/boss + per-row bonus); spent at shop nodes. tierBudgetMult multiplies archetype damageBudget for elite/boss nodes ON TOP of per-row escalation. Prices scale with map depth via priceRowMult.
